title: Time Line for Foreign Policy to 272 BCE
author: Ancient
content:
Foreign Policy of Republican Rome to 272

	509 	Treaty between Rome and Carthage.

	496 	Victory at Lake Regillus by A. Postumius Albus (Rome over the Latin
League).

	493 	Treaty with the Latin League, 
foedus Cassianum
 (Sourcebook #
20).

	491	Coriolanus turned away from Rome.

	484	Tusculum regained from the Aequi.

	483-474	War with Veii.

	479	Defeat of the Fabian  
gens 
 on the Cremera hill.  Siege of Rome? 

	474 	Trad'n of 40 years peace with Veii.

	467 	Treaty with the Aequi a 
foedus iniquum
? (Sourcebook # 21)

	458 	Defeat of L. Minucius by the Aequi near Mt. Algidus (Cincinnatus).

	444	Treaty with Ardea.

	431	Aequi defeated at Mt. Algidus (garrison there, 418).

	428 	Cossus the consul wins 
spolia opima 
from Lars Tolumnius of Veii.

	425 	Fall of Fidenae (weakened by loss of support from Veii).

	396 	Peace with the Volsci?

	396 	Camillus takes Veii by undermining the walls (?). 4 new tribes. Ager
Veiens 		contiguous with Rome. 

	393 	Aequi ejected from Tibur. 

	390 	Gallic invasion (Insubres, Senones) through Etruria. Gallia Cisalpina its
legacy. 

		Battle of Allia (
ater dies, 
July 18); 10,000 Romans die on north bank
of Tiber.

	389 	Decisive defeat of the Aequi.

	387 	Construction of Servian Wall (under Camillus?).

	390-377	Numerous revolts in the Latin League.

	361 	Hernici lose Ferentinum. Tibur and Praeneste join the Hernici against
Rome. 

	360 	Gallic incursion around Alba; Rome besieged. 

	359-351	War between the Latin League and the Etruscans. 

	358 	Hernici forced back into the alliance. Foedus Cassianum renewed (or now
1st 		concluded?).

	354 	Alliance of Rome with the Samnites.

	353	Caere granted 
civitas sine suffragio 
(citizenship w/o vote or
eligibility for office) or 		just a truce. 

	348 	Second Treaty with Carthage.

	343-341	First Samnite War?

	341 	Treaty between Rome and the Samnites.

	340 	Latin allies demand full voting rights, Roman citizenship? 

		Roman & Samnite (?) victory at Trifanum over rebellious Latins.

	338 	Final settlement of Latium (Sourcebook # 22). 

	334 	Colony at Cales (border between Campania and Samnium).

	331 	Treaty between Rome and the Sinones.

	326-304	Second Samnite War.

	311-304	War with the Etruscans.

	310 	Roman victory at Ciminian Hills takes heart out of Etruscan rebellion. 

	311 	Roman Navy nascent (
duoviri navales
).

	306 	Bogus third treaty between Rome and Carthage (Livy 9.43). 

	304	Roman victory at Bovianum Vetus in Samnium.

	298-290	Third Samnite War.

	282-272	War with Tarentum and Pyrrhus.

	280 	Victory of Pyrrhus at Heracleia.

	279 	Third Treaty with Carthage against Pyrrhus.  

		Victory of Pyrrhus at Asculum (Pyrrhic victory).  

	278-276	Pyrrhus in Sicily.

	275	Roman victory over Pyrrhus at Beneventum in Samnium.

	273 	
Amicitia 
between Rome and King Ptolemy II Philadelphos. 

	272 	Death of Pyrrhus in Epiros.
